Jobs & Opportunities

Working for SEED Madagascar is so much more than a job. You will gain invaluable in-country experience, a new perspective and life-long friends. For the most part, our international team are volunteers who are expected to cover personal costs, but some positions may come with a local stipend or contributions to travel costs. 

Interested in volunteering?

Get a taste of life in Madagascar and make a real contribution to our projects in just 2-8 weeks. Apply today!
